entities.name: WNT2
observations: WNT2 expression was elevated in cervical cancer; knockdown reduced SiHa-cell motility and invasion and reversed EMT via WNT2/β-catenin signaling.

entities.name: Cervical carcinoma
observations: In a clinical cervical-cancer cohort, high WNT2 expression was significantly associated with pelvic lymph-node metastasis and adverse pathologic features.

entities.name: PMID:27513465
observations: 2016 PLOS ONE study: WNT2 knockdown reduced SiHa-cell motility and invasion and reversed EMT; clinical WNT2 overexpression correlated with pelvic lymph-node metastasis. DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0160414.
